comparison.objective: Orient and press a rocker switch into a panel cutout; candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Pick, rotate, align, insert, and seat a keyed snap-in component squarely.
comparison.success_condition: Scores insertion depth, squareness, I-mark orientation, hands-off retention, and settling; candidate scores lock-preserved angle and cycling.
comparison.reason: Panel insertion and orientation are different tested abilities from two-tool threaded adjustment.
